$schema_note: Harness-neutral hook catalog (origin: #173 · 2026-08-12). Compiled into each harness's native hooks.json by scripts/compile_prompts.py, using that harness's compile.json 'hook_dialect' (rendering schema) and 'hook_ids' (which of these hooks it ships — an explicit, reviewable capability declaration, not an accident of hand-maintenance).

hooks.command:
cfg="${{{ project_dir_env }}:-$PWD}/{{ agents_dir }}/team.toml"; fallback="${{{ project_dir_env }}:-$PWD}/{{ config_dir }}/team.toml"; legacy="${{{ project_dir_env }}:-$PWD}/{{ config_dir }}/team.config"; if [ -f "$cfg" ]; then printf '=== mARC :: per-repo team.toml (channel topic) ===
'; cat "$cfg"; printf '
=== end team.toml ===
'; elif [ -f "$fallback" ]; then printf '=== mARC :: per-repo team.toml (channel topic) ===
'; cat "$fallback"; printf '
=== end team.toml ===
'; printf '[mARC] DEPRECATED path: {{ config_dir }}/team.toml — re-run /marc:init to migrate to {{ agents_dir }}/team.toml (it will offer to remove the old file).
'; elif [ -f "$legacy" ]; then printf '[mARC] DEPRECATED: {{ config_dir }}/team.config found but mARC now reads {{ agents_dir }}/team.toml (or {{ config_dir }}/team.toml as a fallback) — re-run /marc:init (or convert by hand from docs/team.toml.example) to migrate; the old {{ config_dir }}/team.config file is no longer parsed.
'; else printf '[mARC] no {{ agents_dir }}/team.toml (or {{ config_dir }}/team.toml) in this repo — @techlead will fall back to runtime discovery (gh repo view / gh project list). Add one from docs/team.toml.example to pin repo/project facts.
'; fi; exit 0

data="${{{ plugin_root_env }}:-$HOME/.copilot/plugin-data/marc}"; mkdir -p "$data/scripts"; if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then root=""; while IFS= read -r cand; do [ -n "$cand" ] || continue; nm="$(jq -r '.name // empty' "$cand" 2>/dev/null)"; [ "$nm" = "marc" ] || continue; rp="$(jq -r '.repository // empty' "$cand" 2>/dev/null)"; hp="$(jq -r '.homepage // empty' "$cand" 2>/dev/null)"; case "$rp $hp" in *NexaDuo/mARC*) root="${cand%/plugin.json}"; break ;; esac; done < <(find "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins" -maxdepth 5 -type f -path '*/marc/plugin.json' 2>/dev/null | sort); if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -d "$root/scripts" ]; then cp -f "$root"/scripts/*.py "$data/scripts/" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; exit 0

sent="${{{ plugin_root_env }}:-$HOME/.copilot/plugin-data/marc}/scripts/token_sentinel.py"; if [ -f "$sent" ]; then if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$sent" --hook 2>/dev/null || true; fi; else echo "[mARC] hook script not found: $sent (has sessionStart run yet in this session?)" >&2; fi; exit 0
